title: Zoho Desk Review (2026)
intro: Zoho Desk is evaluated here as a helpdesk / ticketing platform — Zoho Desk is Zoho's helpdesk and customer support platform with ticketing, knowledge base, and multichannel inbox. Free plan for up to 3 agents; annual USD per-agent pricing: Express $7, Standard $14, Professional $23, Enterprise $40 per agent/month billed annually. Pricing page may display INR in some regions — USD floors verified from first-party USD selector. Suite-adjacent with Zoho CRM. Scored as helpdesk-ticketing primary. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Zoho Desk when helpdesk value and Zoho suite alignment matter — especially with free 3-agent or $7 Express entry.
verdict: Choose Zoho Desk when helpdesk value and Zoho suite alignment matter — especially with free 3-agent or $7 Express entry. Compare Freshdesk for Freshworks parity, Help Scout for SMB inbox simplicity, and Zendesk Suite for enterprise omnichannel scale. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
